meta.name: customer-journey-map
meta.description: Create an end-to-end customer journey map with stages, touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities. Use when mapping the customer experience, identifying friction points, improving onboarding, or visualizing the user journey.

copy.tagline: 绘制客户旅程地图，发现体验痛点与机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统梳理客户触点并改善体验
copy.tagline_en: Map customer journeys to uncover pain points and opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically map customer touchpoints and improve experience

howto.what: Claude 会生成一份端到端的客户旅程地图，包含阶段、触点、情绪、痛点和改进机会。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制客户旅程地图、分析用户体验、识别摩擦点或改进用户引导流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个电商App的客户旅程地图。
say.note: Claude 会输出从认知到推荐的完整旅程。

say.text: 分析我们产品的用户流失点。
say.note: Claude 会识别各阶段的痛点和改进机会。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate an end-to-end customer journey map with stages, touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to map customer journey, analyze user experience, identify friction points, or improve onboarding.

say_en.text: Create a customer journey map for an e-commerce app.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a full journey from awareness to advocacy.

say_en.text: Analyze churn points in our product.
say_en.note: Claude identifies pain points and opportunities at each stage.
